title: Snap reports Q3 revenue up 14% YoY to $1.72B, in line with est., and DAUs up 4% to 495M, vs. 499M est.; SNAP drops 9%+ after hours (Spencer Soper/Bloomberg)
summary: Spencer Soper / Bloomberg: Snap reports Q3 revenue up 14% YoY to $1.72B, in line with est., and DAUs up 4% to 495M, vs. 499M est.; SNAP drops 9%+ after hours — Snap Inc. fell after the company reported third-quarter ad revenue and user growth that missed estimates, with Chief Executive Officer Evan Spiegel acknowledging that …
